category.name: Hinges
category.description: Replacement screen hinges and hinge kits for the laptop models we see most often in for repair — a loose or cracked hinge is one of the most common reasons a screen stops sitting straight.

faqs.question: How do I know if it's the hinge and not the screen?
faqs.answer: If the screen won't stay upright, feels loose, or you hear cracking near the edges when opening or closing the lid, it's usually the hinge rather than the panel. Send us a short video on WhatsApp and we can help you confirm.

faqs.question: Does the kit include both sides?
faqs.answer: Yes — each listing is a full left-and-right hinge kit for that model unless stated otherwise.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: It requires opening the display bezel, so most customers have it fitted by us or a technician. We can recommend the fitting process on WhatsApp.
